//: AUTO-INTEGRATION: hardens the EMPTY double-wide user-area wrapper into
a LEF/GDS/nl pin template. Users copy this config, drop their design
//empty: Truly-empty template: elaborate-only (no standard cells) + every
//empty3: block is just a die outline with boundary pins + PDN. This mirrors
//empty4: the caravel openframe empty-wrapper flow and keeps RAM tiny.
//empty-routing: An empty pin template has no routable nets, so
//empty-routing3: aborts with EST-0005. GlobalRouting has no RUN_* gate, so it
//empty-routing4: (and the antenna/diode steps that crash without routing guides)
//empty-routing5: are nulled via substituting_steps. Mid-PnR STA safely falls
//empty-routing6: back to placement-based parasitics when no routes exist.
//empty-routing7: CheckAntennas appears twice in the flow (ids CheckAntennas and
//empty-routing8: CheckAntennas-1), so a trailing '*' wildcard removes both.
//no-std-cells: elaborate only -> no technology mapping, no gates, no dfflibmap
//disabled-steps: OpenLane-1 RUN_* equivalents from the openframe reference
//no-routing: No routable nets in the empty template: skip detailed routing,
//no-routing2: parasitics extraction (RCX) and multi-corner post-PnR STA.
//pdn-match: Every PDN_* / FP_* geometry variable below must stay byte-for-byte
//pdn-match4: check for double_wide compares the geometry that pokes outside each
//pdn-match5: wrapper's own DIE_AREA (erase_box_double_wide.tcl) against this golden
//pdn-match6: reference's GDS, and the fixed-pin-template ports in pin_template.def
//pdn-match7: straddle that die edge by design (+-2um) -- any mismatch in how PDN
//pdn-match8: stripes are promoted onto those pins (CORE_AREA margin, pitch, offset,
//pdn-match9: layer) shows up as an XOR difference even though this design is empty.
//pin-template: Exact, pad-aligned pin locations (generated by scripts/
//pin-template2: extract_openframe_pads.py). Replaces the pin-placement algo so
//pin-template3: the padframe's pad<->wrapper nets are short straight hops.
//native-pdn-to-pins2: promotes the stdcell PDN grid straight to the fixed pin_template.def
//native-pdn-to-pins3: pin locations without any custom stitching step: OpenROAD.GeneratePDN
//native-pdn-to-pins4: already knows where every power/ground BTerm is from FP_DEF_TEMPLATE,
//native-pdn-to-pins5: and -pins on add_pdn_stripe/define_pdn_grid makes it promote the grid
//native-pdn-to-pins6: stripes that reach those BTerms into real BPins. This replaced an older
//native-pdn-to-pins7: hand-rolled approach (a custom Wrapper.AddPowerEdgePorts ODB-Python step
//native-pdn-to-pins8: that parsed pin_template.def and manually stitched met3 edge ports onto
//native-pdn-to-pins9: the nearest PDN stripe) now that this LibreLane version can do it itself.
